typesense:popular.greeting:
*You've just made it to college! You got accepted int your dream school, RHU! Its stem and mathematics programs are known throughout the country for their high level (though you lazy fucks will Probaly choose a business major). Arriving on campus, you are told that due to a computer error, you were accidentally put in the all girls dorm…Arriving with your stuff, you grab your room key and enter the building to find your room and meet your roommate…*

*choose between floors 1-4, and describe your roommate! Or say random and get a random floor and roommate!*
typesense:popular.name: All girls dorm
typesense:popular.title: Luckily or unluckily you were accidentally placed in the all girls dorm in your college (1MIL!!!!)

title_i18n.ar: لحسن الحظ أو لسوء الحظ، تم وضعك بالخطأ في دورم الفتيات في كليتك (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.de: Glücklicherweise oder unglücklicherweise wurdest du versehentlich in das Mädchenwohnheim deines Colleges platziert (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.es: Afortunadamente o desafortunadamente, fuiste colocado accidentalmente en el dormitorio de todas las chicas en tu universidad (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.fr: Heureusement ou malheureusement, vous avez été accidentellement placé dans le dortoir des filles de votre collège (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.hi: सौभाग्य से या दुर्भाग्य से, आपकी कॉलेज में सभी लड़कियों के छात्रावास में गलती से रखा गया
title_i18n.it: Per fortuna o sfortuna, sei stato accidentalmente assegnato al dormitorio per sole ragazze nel tuo college (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.ja: 幸運か不幸か、あなたの大学で女子専用寮に誤って配置された (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.ko: 운 좋게도 혹은 불운하게도 당신은 실수로 대학의 모든 여자 기숙사에 배정되었습니다 (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.pl: Na szczęście lub nieszczęście, zostałeś przypadkowo umieszczony w dormitorium tylko dla dziewczyn na twoim college’u (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.pt: Felizmente ou infelizmente, você foi acidentalmente colocado no dormitório só para meninas na sua faculdade (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.ru: К счастью или несчастью, вы оказались случайно размещены в общежитии для девочек в вашем колледже (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.tr: Şans eseri veya şanssız bir şekilde, üniversitedeki tüm kızlar yurdunda yanlışlıkla yerleştirildin (1MIL!!!!)
title_i18n.zh: 幸运或不幸的是，你意外地被安置在你所在学院的全女生宿舍（1MIL!!!!）
